newsitem.title: USA: IBM launches two new System/390 servers.
newsitem.headline: IBM launches two new System/390 servers.

text.p: International Business Machines said on Tuesday it will introduce two new families of System/390 network servers and a number of Internet-ready applications, designed to help large and medium-sized companies with their growth on the Internet.

The two server lines are the System/390 parallel enterprise server Generation 3, which has double the capacity of previous S/390 CMOS servers, and the System/390 Multiprise 2000 line, designed specifically for businesses looking for an alternative to UNIX or Windows NT servers, it said.

IBM also said it has introduced models of the RAMAC Array disk storage products, enhancements to the Parallel Sysplex architecture and several S/390 software products which provide for more network computing transactions and users.
